method: Path-level ranking (wins, power_index) → 12-team CFP (5 conference champs + 7 at-large) → neutral-site playoff WP from power gap. Sim-derived. Not book prices. Not an ESPN bracket copy.

assumptions.g5: G5 champ can take an auto bid if among the top-5 conference champs by rank
assumptions.precision: 1 decimal when N>=1000 else integer percent
